page.overview:
Who is Cam Spinner?

Cam Spinner is one of the next-generation racers and is sponsored by TripleDent Gum. He wears the number 31. Sometime during the 2016 mid-season, he replaces Terry Kargas. In 2017, where he started in the 15th position. In 2017, he competed in the Florida 500. He later causes the huge accident in the Florida 500 after losing control and hitting other racers, he received severe damage and he didn’t finish the race.

Cam Spinner is an unlockable playable character in Cars 3: Driven to Win. Like most of the playable characters, he is unlocked by completing an uncertain amount of skill checks.
